# Vedic Wisdom

> Authentic Non-Demolition Spatial Vastu & Classical KP Cuspal Interlink (CIL) Astrology platform founded by Sandeep K. Tripathi and Ravindra Pathak in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India.

Vedic Wisdom bridges timeless Vedic scriptural traditions with modern non-destructive spatial harmonisation and high-precision predictive KP astrology. All consultations, automated dossiers, and remedies adhere strictly to traditional faith-based scriptural foundations with zero physical demolition.

## Core Offerings

- [Industrial & Factory Vastu Consultations](https://vedic-wisdom-ant.vercel.app/#consultations): On-site diagnostic evaluations for industrial manufacturing plants, corporate tech hubs, and luxury estates using calibrated Lecher Antenna and 16-zone elemental energy rebalancing with zero physical demolition.
- [Classical KP Astrology Consultations](https://vedic-wisdom-ant.vercel.app/#consultations): Deep-dive predictive astrological sessions using Krishnamurti Padhdhati (KP System), Cuspal Interlinks (CIL), Sub-Sub Lords, and Bhrigu Nandi Nadi transits.
- [AI Vedic Dossier Generator](https://vedic-wisdom-ant.vercel.app/#digital-reports): Instant computational Vedic birth chart calculation, Vimshottari Dasha mapping, and high-resolution downloadable PDF dossiers.
- [Free Calculators & Panchang](https://vedic-wisdom-ant.vercel.app/#free-calculators): Real-time Surya Siddhanta panchang, Choghadiya auspicious windows, Rahu Kaal timers, and North-Indian interactive Kundli chart generator.
- [Vedic Wisdom Academy](https://vedic-wisdom-ant.vercel.app/#academy): Masterclasses and practical certification curricula in KP Cuspal Interlinks, Industrial Vastu, and Lecher Antenna measurement.
